abi_version.description: ABI version string (e.g., '<abi/3.0>', 'kernel'); defines which language features are available

allow_all.description: If true, adds 'all,' rule (allows everything — for testing only)

allow_all_qualifiers.description: Qualifiers for the 'all' rule, e.g., 'audit' or 'deny'

attach_path.description: Optional execution attachment path (e.g., '/usr/bin/myapp'); used for profile matching

audit_rules.description: List of rule types to always audit (e.g., ['file /etc/shadow r'])

capabilities.description: List of Linux capabilities (lowercase, no 'CAP_' prefix) required, e.g., ['net_bind_service']

change_profile_rules.description: List of change_profile rules: each is {exec_mode?, exec_cond?, target}; target is target profile name

dbus_rules.description: List of DBus rules: each is {qualifiers?, access?, bus?, name?, path?, interface?, member?, peer?}; bus e.g. 'system'; peer is list of dicts with name/label

debug.description: If true, enable debug flag in profile header

file_rules.description: List of file rules: each is {qualifiers?, owner?, type, path, access?, target?}; access e.g. 'rwl', target e.g. 'unconfined' for exec transitions

mount_rules.description: List of mount rules: each is {qualifiers?, action, fstype?, fstype_cond?, options?, options_cond?, source, dest}; action is 'mount', 'remount' or 'umount'

network_rules.description: List of network rules: each is {domain, type, local?, peer?}; domain e.g. 'inet', type e.g. 'tcp', local e.g. '127.0.0.1', peer is dict with ip and port

profile_flags.description: List of profile flags (e.g., ['debug', 'mediate_deleted']); affects profile behavior globally

profile_name.description: Unique name for the AppArmor profile (no spaces or quotes needed unless special chars)

rlimit_rules.description: List of rlimit rules: each is {resource, operator, value}; resource e.g. 'nofile', operator e.g. '<=', value e.g. '1024' or '1G'

signal_rules.description: List of signal rules: each is {qualifiers?, access?, set?, peer?}; set is list of signal names like ['term', 'hup']; peer is label string

unix_rules.description: List of Unix socket rules: each is {qualifiers?, access?, type?, protocol?, local?, peer?}; e.g. access='connect', local='@/tmp/foo', peer is list of dicts with label/addr
